references.text: A prophecy from Moses that God will raise up a prophet among their brothers, like him (Moses), whom the people must listen to.
The prophecy from Zechariah that the daughter of Zion should rejoice greatly because her king comes, humble and riding on a donkey.
The fulfillment of the prophecy that the Messiah would be called a Nazarene.

The fulfillment of the prophecy from Isaiah that the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, the way to the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles, the people who sat in darkness have seen a great light.
